                CASE WHEN pm25 IS NOT NULL THEN trip_count END

weather_demand_variation_silver.sql:
WITH rates AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_location_id,
        pickup_zone,
        try_divide(trip_count, observed_hours) AS demand_per_hour,
        observed_hours
    FROM zone_weather
    WHERE weather IN ('dry', 'wet')
),
variation AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_location_id,
        pickup_zone,
        MAX(demand_per_hour) - MIN(demand_per_hour) AS demand_range,
        MIN(observed_hours) AS minimum_exposure_hours
    FROM rates
    GROUP BY pickup_location_id, pickup_zone
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
    *,
    dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY demand_range DESC) AS demand_rank
FROM variation
ORDER BY demand_rank, pickup_location_id

WITH months AS (
    SELECT
        trunc(local_date, 'month') AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT local_date) AS observed_days,
        SUM(trip_count) AS trip_count
    FROM hourly_demand
    GROUP BY trunc(local_date, 'month')
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        lag(trip_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_trips
    FROM months
)
SELECT
    *,
    try_divide(trip_count, observed_days) AS avg_daily_demand,
    100.0 * try_divide(
        trip_count - previous_month_trips,
        previous_month_trips
    ) AS change_pct
FROM changes
ORDER BY month

        trunc(local_date, 'month') AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT local_date) AS observed_days
    FROM calendar_hours
    GROUP BY trunc(local_date, 'month')
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        trunc(pickup_date, 'month') AS month,
        SUM(trip_count) AS trip_count
    FROM gold_daily_mobility_summary
    GROUP BY trunc(pickup_date, 'month')
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        m.month,
        m.observed_days,
        coalesce(t.trip_count, 0L) AS trip_count,
        lag(coalesce(t.trip_count, 0L)) OVER (
            ORDER BY m.month
        ) AS previous_month_trips
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN totals t
        ON m.month = t.month
)
SELECT
    *,
    try_divide(trip_count, observed_days) AS avg_daily_demand,
    100.0 * try_divide(
        trip_count - previous_month_trips,
        previous_month_trips
    ) AS change_pct
FROM changes
ORDER BY month

WITH rates AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_location_id,
        pickup_zone,
        try_divide(trip_count, observed_hours) AS demand_per_hour,
        observed_hours
    FROM zone_weather
    WHERE weather IN ('dry', 'wet')
),
variation AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_location_id,
        pickup_zone,
        MAX(demand_per_hour) - MIN(demand_per_hour) AS demand_range,
        MIN(observed_hours) AS minimum_exposure_hours
    FROM rates
    GROUP BY pickup_location_id, pickup_zone
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
    *,
    dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY demand_range DESC) AS demand_rank
FROM variation
ORDER BY demand_rank, pickup_location_id
